products.title: Hiroki 'FTE' Sunday Golf Bag - Stone Grey
products.body_html:
For the Elements. For the Game.


Conquer unpredictable conditions with the Hiroki ‘FTE’ Sunday Golf Bag, meticulously developed with expanded PTFE fabric technology for unmatched waterproofing, durability, and functionality. Whether navigating dewy fairways or unexpected rain, this bag ensures all-weather reliability without compromising on style and performance. 


Key Features:

  • Hiroki Waterproof FTE Tech Fabric – superior protection against the elements
  • Waterproof lining & YKK zips – secure, weather-resistant storage
  • Premium genuine leather accents & reinforced leather base – built for durability and style
  • Thick padded strap with suede detailing – comfortable carry, round after round
  • 8” opening with single divider – streamlined club organization
  • Collapsible design – easy transport and storage

products.title: LOFG x Hiroki Sunday Golf Bag
products.body_html:
The Hiroki x LOFG Sunday Golf Bag is where creative expression meets expert craftsmanship. This exclusive collaboration with Left of Field pays tribute to the bush landscapes of Australia’s East Coast, drawing inspiration from the natural surroundings that shaped LOFG founder Nick Ilias.

Crafted from waxed canvas with suede accents, the bag is a statement of both durability and design. 
The distinctive front pocket features a print inspired by the Sydney Red Gum Tree (Angophora Costata / Kajimbourra)—a symbol of the urban bushland of Sydney. 
Accented with yellow leather trims, the design reflects the vibrant blooms that signal the changing seasons while echoing Australia’s iconic green and gold hues.

Key Features:

  • Waxed canvas body for durability and a timeless look
  • Sydney Red Gum Tree-inspired print on the front pocket
  • Waterproof lining to protect essentials in all conditions
  • LOFG Flower Logo embossed leather base for a signature touch
  • Premium leather accents and suede detailing for a refined feel
  • Two large pockets, including a waterproof valuables pocket
  • Thick padded strap with suede detailing for comfort
  • Premium Cobra clips for lasting strength
  • 8” opening with a single divider
  • Collapsible design for easy transport and storage

products.title: Utility Sunday Golf Bag
products.body_html:
Inspired by the rugged durability of industrial workwear, the Hiroki Utility Sunday Golf Bag is crafted for golfers who demand both function and style. 


Designed with heavy-duty waxed canvas, premium leather accents, and precision-engineered brass YKK zippers, this bag is made to withstand the elements while maintaining an elevated look.

Key Features:

  • Heavy-duty waxed canvas for lasting durability
  • Premium brass YKK zippers and aluminum Cobra clips
  • Waterproof lined interior to protect essentials
  • Large front and side pockets for extra storage
  • Suede-detailed, thick padded strap for all-day comfort
  • Leather base for enhanced structure and longevity
  • 8” opening with a single divider for a streamlined carry
  • Collapsible design for easy storage
